pending_interview.question: A mid-sized logistics company comes to you early in an FDE engagement. They want to add AI-powered demand forecasting to their operations — predicting how much inventory to stock at each warehouse location in advance. They currently use a spreadsheet-based process owned by one analyst. Their data lives in three separate systems that have never been connected: an ERP (enterprise resource planning) system for orders, a warehouse management system for inventory, and a TMS (transportation management system) for shipments. They have 18 months of clean historical data. Walk me through how you would scope this engagement, what tradeoffs you'd surface for the client in the first two weeks, and how you'd reason through whether to build a custom forecasting model versus buying an existing solution.
